entries.26e059c8b10e80c1: It sets the code of conduct 'Gentle, strong, and interesting,' and considers the company's future in three stages, ordered from the most distant in time: 'distant view,' 'middle view' and 'near view.' Citing as its challenges the launch and nurturing of 'places' that provide 'good time,' expanding markets in Japan and overseas, securing and developing diverse talent, and strengthening management foundations such as IT systems and supply chains, it says it will increase the types and volume of content and continue to create and nurture new 'places.'

entries.c8b71e20201dda6a: This single-segment business combines web media, such as the website “Hobonichi,” with sales of products led by the “Hobonichi Techo.” It creates a “place” where content creators and audiences meet, delivering content such as readings and videos along with products such as planners and miscellaneous goods. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥8,677 million. Its main locations are the store TOBICHI in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, which also serves as its head office; TOBICHI Kyoto in Kyoto, Kyoto Prefecture; the event space Hobonichi Nichiyobi in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo; and the studio of Hobonichi no Gakkō in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo.
